notes: The empty spell surface emits C's Cast what where? line.
The second do_cast registration is reachable and preserves the shared normal-class entry bytes.
Unquoted spell input reaches the exact magick-symbol rejection before lookup or RNG.
Unknown quoted input emits the normal Cast what?!? branch.
C's strtok remainder accepts an opening quote with a nonempty end-of-input spell name; the known violent spell then reaches the no-target prompt.
An explicit absent character target preserves Okay, the out-of-room incantation, and Cannot find the target of your spell! with no peer target output.
The successful flame-arrow call reaches shared C damage protection for the level-1 non-outlaw peer and emits Ancient forces protect without changing HP.
The target remainder is passed through one_argument, so only the first non-fill token is resolved.
A violent spell with no target preserves the exact Upon who prompt before any concentration draw.
A named violent self-target reaches the exact self-harm refusal before mana or RNG.
C's second find_skill_num arm accepts an abbreviation for each token of a multiword spell name.
A mortal psionic using the literal cast command receives the exact will-only refusal before parsing.
Psionic and mystic callers use Will wording for blank, unquoted, unknown, known-but-targetless, and power lookup branches.
The successful concentration path enters cast_spell and rejects zero intelligence or wisdom before Okay, mana spend, or wait state.
Charm-master, self-only, not-self, and group restrictions preserve C's ordering and psionic/mystic wording.
The carrying-weight ratio maps to C's 0/5/7/10 concentration additions, including the empty and ratio-at-least-four cases.
Character room/world and object inventory/equipment/room/world resolution retain C's ordered target flags and empty-target defaults.
Insufficient mortal mana rejects before the concentration draw and leaves resources unchanged.
A failed concentration consumes the one roll, applies the one-round wait, halves mana, and emits no incantation.
The successful spoken-cast boundary preserves Okay, CallMagic's effect, full mana cost, wait state, and downstream RNG order.

SaySpell/CallMagic payloads and spell damage messaging are shared spell-parser behavior already owned by the object-magic and native magic-user manifests; this slice proves the PC entry boundary and its C damage protection gate.
Player command dispatch cannot enter do_cast with an NPC; NPC magic enters cast_spell through registered special procedures, owned by mob.magic-user-combat-cast.
